svg.title: The federal 25C and 25D HVAC tax credits and when they ended
svg.desc: The 25C Energy Efficient Home Improvement Credit doesn't apply to property placed in service after December 31, 2025; it covered heat pumps, central air, furnaces, boilers, heat pump water heaters, panels, insulation and audits. The 25D Residential Clean Energy Credit doesn't apply to expenditures after December 31, 2025; it covered geothermal heat pumps, solar and battery storage. 2025 installs can still be claimed.
